entity.name: SocketIO4j
entity.description: SocketIO4j is an open-source organisation maintaining Netty-SocketIO, a Java Socket.IO server implementation built on Netty. Contributions help sustain ongoing maintenance, security updates, protocol compatibility, performance improvements, interoperability testing, documentation, and community support.

projects.name: Netty-SocketIO (SocketIO4j)
projects.description: An open-source Socket.IO server for Java built on Netty, supporting real-time bidirectional communication and integrations with Java application frameworks. Funding supports long-term maintenance, testing across Socket.IO client versions, performance optimisation, bug fixes, documentation, and infrastructure.

channels.description: Support SocketIO4j through its Open Collective page.

plans.name: One-time contribution
plans.description: Make a one-time contribution of any amount to help sustain SocketIO4j development and maintenance.

plans.name: Monthly sponsorship
plans.description: Provide recurring monthly support for ongoing maintenance, testing, documentation, and project infrastructure.
